title: fix: seed Open WebUI task model with a non-reasoning model
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Seeds `TASK_MODEL_EXTERNAL` as `openai/gpt-5.4-nano`. `gpt-5-nano` spent 256–1024 reasoning tokens and 3–12 s per title, tags and follow-up call; `gpt-5.4-nano` answers in ~2.3 s with none.
- The live `task.model.external` config rows in prod and staging were updated directly (env values only seed an empty config table). This keeps a fresh database consistent.
- Verified on production: Enter-to-reply 17.6 s → 5.3 s; all task calls now at ~2.3 s.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Replies found their wings
gist.blurb: Open WebUI's little task runner has been given a faster, non-reasoning brain. Polli watched the waiting time shrink while the titles and tags kept arriving on schedule.
gist.summary: Open WebUI now seeds TASK_MODEL_EXTERNAL with openai/gpt-5.4-nano instead of gpt-5-nano, avoiding 256–1024 reasoning tokens per task and bringing task calls to about 2.3 seconds.
gist.impact: Enter-to-reply on the production Open WebUI flow drops from 17.6 seconds to 5.3 seconds, so titles, tags, and follow-up tasks finish much sooner.

Polli, wearing tiny speed goggles, guides the cards toward a compact glowing model seed labeled “5.4 nano,” while code-plants and flowers show that the faster task model keeps the conversation garden moving.
